title: My Grown-Up Christmas List
description: A journalist and a military man share a special bond that grows between them over the course of several Christmases they spend together and apart.

title: Unlocking Christmas
description: When a mysterious key and a cryptic holiday riddle arrive on their doorsteps, Kate and Kevin embark on a romantic Christmas adventure.

title: Write Before Christmas
description: Jessica sends Christmas cards to five people who have greatly impacted her life, including the aunt who raised her, her brother, an aging pop star, the teacher that inspired her and her friend that always tells the truth.

title: Five More Minutes
description: Inspired by Scotty McCreery's song "Five More Minutes," a woman's Christmas wish is answered in unexpected ways when her late grandfather's journal turns up and reveals an untold romance.

title: A Merry Scottish Christmas
description: When estranged siblings Lindsay and Brad Morgan travel to Scotland at Christmas to reunite with their mother Jo, a big family secret is revealed.

title: Our Holiday Story
description: A loving couple shares the story of how they met and fell in love when their daughter's boyfriend comes to meet them for the first time at Christmas.

title: A Danish Christmas
description: Marie helps her family's Copenhagen inn at Christmas when Ryan arrives, and she mistakes him for a travel writer. She curates a tour in search of hygge, and the two find a connection as well.

title: A Bramble House Christmas
description: While settling his father's estate, a man becomes suspicious as to why the man left his nurse a large sum of money after knowing her for less than two months before he died.

title: Merry Memories
description: Michaela helps her nephew create a Christmas Scrapbook for his mom serving overseas by teaming with his teacher Bryan. Their unexpected romance proves love can be the greatest homecoming of all.

title: Holiday Unplugged
description: When Sally loses years of precious family videos, she convinces her family to go "no tech" for the holidays, enlisting former teacher Damon to help recover the videos in time for Christmas.

title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
description: Sparks fly between an ambitious freelance reporter and a handsome firefighter after she lands a feel-good story about a Chicago Bears superfan who's about to attend her 500th game.

title: A Christmas Carousel
description: Lila is hired by the royal family of Ancadia to repair a carousel and must work with the prince to complete it by Christmas.

title: Three Wiser Men and a Boy
description: The Brenner brothers return and put on a holiday pageant for young Thomas while trying to cope with life's curveballs, including their mom's new boyfriend.

title: A Newport Christmas
description: The charitable Ella heads out on a boat in 1905 and ends up in 2025. Nick has to figure out how to get her back in time and decide if their newfound love can stand the test of it.

title: Christmas With the Singhs
description: Newly engaged Asha Singh and Jake O'Brien are excited to spend Christmas together, but their relationship is tested when their families' cultural and holiday traditions clash.

title: November Christmas
description: A community works together to help a couple bring an early Christmas to their sick 8-year-old daughter (Emily Alyn Lind).

title: A Godwink Christmas
description: As Christmas approaches, Paula reluctantly accepts a marriage proposal from her boyfriend. When her Aunt Jane invites Paula to her Nantucket home, she bonds with a charming inn owner.

title: Snowbound for the Holidays
description: Hotel manager Cassidy Evergreen evaluates a cozy ski lodge, but Christmas magic and its charming owner, Trey Sanderson, turn a simple assignment into a heartfelt choice between duty and love.

title: Who's Coming for Christmas?
description: Inspired by her late grandmother, Julie plans Christmas Eve dinner in her new home, without a guest list, and has faith that the eight seats around her table will be filled by friends and neighbors.

title: Crown for Christmas
description: After getting fired from her job as a maid at a ritzy New York City hotel, a woman accepts a temporary job as governess to a young girl who is part of a powerful European family.

title: Holiday Unplugged
description: When Sally loses years of precious family videos, she convinces her family to go "no tech" for the holidays, enlisting former teacher Damon to help recover the videos in time for Christmas.
